phases.name: Extreme negative
phases.tableMeaning: Strongly skewed to the negative end; often feared, avoided, distrusted, or opposed.

phases.name: Skewed negative
phases.tableMeaning: Leaning negative but still flexible; NPC reactions are mixed.

phases.name: Neutral or balanced
phases.tableMeaning: True center; stable, adaptable, and open to many paths.

phases.name: Skewed positive
phases.tableMeaning: Leaning positive; trusted by like-minded NPCs and seen as dependable.

phases.name: Extreme positive
phases.tableMeaning: Fully committed to the positive end; revered or hated for strong conviction.
